sentences.text:
National Highway Authority Of India, Represented By Dy General
 Manager Cum Project Director, No.36/414(Iii), Near Nss Higher
 Secondary School, Palkulangara, Trivandrum-695024.
 And 4 Others
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to pass an Interim Order, directing the respondents to disburse
 the balance amount of Rs. 28,12,594/- along with solatium and interest,
 by passing an Award, as determined in Exhibit P8, in respect to the
 residential building, in Sy No. 44/3-4-1 of Pattanakkad Village and the
 compensation for his loss of residence, under the 2nd Schedule of the
 Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, pending final disposal of the
 Writ Petition.

This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition
 and the affidavit filed in support of Wp(C) and this Court's order dated
 04.09.2024 and upon hearing the arguments of Sri. S.Krishnamoorthy, Sneha
 Rose and P.S.Aruna, Advocates for the petitioner, Standing Counsel for R1
 and of Government Pleader for R2 to R5, the court passed the following:
 Order
